comments.body:
Implementation detail for this story (the description carries the decisions).

### (5) Import-convention scans → ruff (`ruff==0.16.3`, `pyproject.toml:257`; verified on the venv's 0.16.2)

Current `[tool.ruff.lint]` (`pyproject.toml:437-495`) selects no TID codes; `ignore` must stay the RUF trio and no `extend-ignore` (`tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py:76-107`), so TID goes in `select` + `per-file-ignores` only. TID251 and TID253 are each ONE global list toggled per path, so at most one scoped rule per code can be expressed.

| test module | rule | ruff expression or STAYS |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py::test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests` (:57-76, bug a371) | no `tests.`-rooted import anywhere under tests/ | FOLD: `select += ["TID251"]`; `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api]` `"tests".msg = "tests.-rooted imports resolve only with the repo root on sys.path, which the bare pytest console script (make test, CI) does not provide; import same-directory helpers by bare name (bug a371)"`. Parent matching covers `import tests.x`, `from tests import x`, `from tests.x import y`, and in-function imports (verified). Keep `test_audit_page_modules_collect_under_bare_pytest` (the bug's repro) |
| `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py::test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope` (:131-148) | no module-scope heavy import under src/rebar except `_engine` | FOLD: `select += ["TID253"]`; `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]` `banned-module-level-imports = ["langchain","langgraph","langchain_anthropic","langchain_openai","langchain_mcp_adapters","langfuse","anthropic","deepagents","opentelemetry","pydantic_ai","httpx","tree_sitter","tree_sitter_language_pack","hcl2","lark"]`; per-file-ignores: `"src/rebar/_engine/**" = ["TID253"]`, extend `:536` to `"tests/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]` and `:578` to `"scripts/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]`. Keep `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack`, reading its list from pyproject via `tomllib` so the list has one source. Both rules are green on the current tree (verified with `--config` overrides) |
| `tests/unit/test_no_reducer_engine_support_cycle.py` (71) | reducer must not module-import `rebar._engine_support` | STAYS: TID253 is claimed by the heavy-stack rule and its scope (all src) differs from this one (reducer only); per-file-ignores cannot scope two lists under one code |
| `tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py` (184, bug 291e) | sibling import preceded by a `__file__`-derived `sys.path.insert` | STAYS: order/derivation condition |
| `tests/unit/workflow/test_executor_tripwire.py::test_executor_imports_no_scheduler_or_retry_lib`, `test_map_fanout_is_the_sole_concurrency_module` | asyncio/threading/retry libs banned in 2 files, required in 1 | STAYS: file-scoped ban + positive presence; TID251 is claimed |
| `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_dependency_direction.py` (63) | reconciler imports only `ticket_reducer`/`event_append` engine seams | STAYS: bare engine names are legitimate elsewhere; TID251 claimed |
| `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_neutrality.py`, `test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py`, `test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py` ADF allowlists | scoped vendor-import bans with allowlists | STAYS: scoped, substring/AST-mixed, and the reconciler epic renames the package |

### Exact TOML for `pyproject.toml`

In `[tool.ruff.lint]` `select` (`:462-486`), add the two codes:

```toml
    "TID251",
    "TID253",
```

New tables (placed after `[tool.ruff.lint]`, before `[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]`):

```toml
[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]
banned-module-level-imports = [
    "langchain",
    "langgraph",
    "langchain_anthropic",
    "langchain_openai",
    "langchain_mcp_adapters",
    "langfuse",
    "anthropic",
    "deepagents",
    "opentelemetry",
    "pydantic_ai",
    "httpx",
    "tree_sitter",
    "tree_sitter_language_pack",
    "hcl2",
    "lark",
]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api]
"tests".msg = "tests.-rooted imports resolve only with the repo root on sys.path, which the bare pytest console script (make test, CI) does not provide; import same-directory helpers by bare name (bug a371)"
```

In `[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]`:

```toml
"src/rebar/_engine/**" = ["TID253"]
"tests/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]      # was "tests/**" = ["T201"] at :536
"scripts/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]    # was "scripts/**" = ["T201"] at :578
```

The `"src/rebar/_engine/**"` key becomes `"src/rebar/reconciler/**"` if the reconciler epic (friended-brainsick-degus) lands its package move first; whichever change lands second updates the path.

### RED proof (record the three transcripts as a comment on this ticket)

```sh
printf 'from tests.unit.nothing import x\n' > tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py && ruff check tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py
# expected: one `TID251 \`tests\` is banned`
printf 'import httpx\n' > src/rebar/_e10_red.py && ruff check src/rebar/_e10_red.py
# expected: one `TID253 \`httpx\` is banned at the module level`
printf 'def f():\n    import httpx\n    return httpx\n' > src/rebar/_e10_red.py && ruff check src/rebar/_e10_red.py
# expected: clean
rm tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py src/rebar/_e10_red.py
```

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Two whole-tree AST scans duplicate what ruff's `flake8-tidy-imports` expresses natively and runs on every `make lint` and pre-commit: `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py::test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests` (`:57-76`, bug a371: no `tests.`-rooted import anywhere under `tests/`) and `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py::test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope` (`:131-148`: no module-scope heavy import under `src/rebar` except `_engine`). The other import scans in table (5) cannot be expressed and STAY: TID251 and TID253 are each ONE global list toggled per path, so at most one scoped rule per code exists, and the remaining scans need an order/derivation condition, a file-scoped ban with positive presence, a reducer-only scope, and vendor allowlists. Current `[tool.ruff.lint]` (`pyproject.toml:437-495`) selects no TID codes; `ignore` must stay the RUF trio with no `extend-ignore` (`tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py:76-107`), so TID goes in `select` + `per-file-ignores` only. Ruff is `ruff==0.16.3` (`pyproject.toml:257`; the rules were verified on the venv's 0.16.2, and both are green on the current tree with `--config` overrides). Table (5) and the exact TOML are itemised in this ticket's first comment. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
- `pyproject.toml`: add `"TID251"` and `"TID253"` to `select` (`:462-486`); add the `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]` table with `banned-module-level-imports = ["langchain","langgraph","langchain_anthropic","langchain_openai","langchain_mcp_adapters","langfuse","anthropic","deepagents","opentelemetry","pydantic_ai","httpx","tree_sitter","tree_sitter_language_pack","hcl2","lark"]` and the `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api]` sub-table with `"tests".msg = "tests.-rooted imports resolve only with the repo root on sys.path, which the bare pytest console script (make test, CI) does not provide; import same-directory helpers by bare name (bug a371)"`; per-file-ignores: add `"src/rebar/_engine/**" = ["TID253"]`, extend `:536` to `"tests/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]` and `:578` to `"scripts/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]`. TID251 parent matching covers `import tests.x`, `from tests import x`, `from tests.x import y`, and in-function imports.
- The per-file-ignore path `src/rebar/_engine/**` becomes `src/rebar/reconciler/**` if the reconciler epic (friended-brainsick-degus) lands its package move first; whichever change lands second updates the path.
- `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py`: delete `test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests` and `_tests_rooted_imports` (+ the then-unused `_tree_scan` import); keep `test_audit_page_modules_collect_under_bare_pytest` (the bug a371 repro).
- `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`: delete `test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope`, `_module_scope_imports`, `_is_heavy`; make `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack` read the banned list from `pyproject.toml` via `tomllib` so the list has one source.
- `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py:1132`: set `_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT = 9` (one `test_core_optionality.py` test fewer; S2 lands first and leaves it at 10).
- Every scan table (5) marks STAYS is untouched: `tests/unit/test_no_reducer_engine_support_cycle.py`, `tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py`, `tests/unit/workflow/test_executor_tripwire.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_dependency_direction.py`, and the reconciler ADF allowlist scans in `test_backend_neutrality.py`, `test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py`, `test_rich_text_seam.py`.

## Scope
In scope: `pyproject.toml`, `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py`, `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`, `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`. Out of scope: every STAYS scan in table (5), `ignore` and `extend-ignore` in `[tool.ruff.lint]`, any RUF per-file entry, and every file under `src/` and `scripts/`.

## Testing
RED proof, run and its three transcripts recorded on this ticket: `printf 'from tests.unit.nothing import x\n' > tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py && ruff check tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py` → one `TID251 \`tests\` is banned`; `printf 'import httpx\n' > src/rebar/_e10_red.py && ruff check src/rebar/_e10_red.py` → one `TID253 \`httpx\` is banned at the module level`; `printf 'def f():\n    import httpx\n    return httpx\n' > src/rebar/_e10_red.py && ruff check src/rebar/_e10_red.py` → clean; remove both scratch files. Then `make lint` green on the real tree; `make test` green; `pytest --collect-only -q tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py` shows exactly 2 fewer nodes than before.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `ruff check --select TID251,TID253 src tests scripts` exits 0.
- [ ] The three RED-proof transcripts (TID251 fires, TID253 fires at module level, TID253 silent for the in-function import) are on this ticket as a comment, and `tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py` and `src/rebar/_e10_red.py` are absent from the tree.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py` passes (`ignore` untouched, no RUF per-file entry).
- [ ] `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack` reads its banned list from `pyproject.toml` (verified by `git grep -n tomllib tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`).
- [ ] The two scan tests and their helpers collect nothing: `pytest --collect-only -q` on the two modules shows exactly 2 fewer nodes, and `_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT == 9` keeps `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` green.
- [ ] `make verify` green.
